blocks.text: VALENCIA CITY, Bukidnon — City health officials here are rushing to secure confirmatory testing for 73 suspected Hepatitis A cases. The move comes following a sharp rise in infections in Barangay Lurugan, a heavily urbanized village surrounded by vast pineapple plantations. Most of those affected are students aged 10 to 19. Aron Apostol Rempohito, chief of the Valencia City Public Information and Assistance Division (PIAD), told the Inquirer on Friday, October 9, that the local government is communicating with hospital officials. This is to finalize a memorandum of agreement (MOA) for diagnostic confirmatory testing. The agreement follows an emergency crisis meeting […]...
